HANDOVERS_DESC: Collect the G1 handover items per style (sample, quote, test, QRS, tech pack); hand over once complete to freeze development data.
CREATE_HINT: One package per style; it is also created automatically when a customer accepts a quote.
COMPLETE_CONFIRM: Hand over #{{styleNo}}? Development data will be frozen; later edits need a change request.
CHANGE_HINT: The package returns to Collecting and must be handed over again after the edits.
REASON_RULE: Enter a reason of at least 2 characters
NOT_APPLICABLE: Not applicable (not enabled in the customer flow)
FROZEN_NOTE: Handed over: the checklist is the snapshot taken at handover.
LIVE_NOTE: Collecting: items are evaluated live; conditions not enabled for the customer do not block.
TECH_PACK_HINT: Upload the spec sheet, size chart and yarn configuration (PDF, Excel, Word)
MANUAL_DESC: Customer rule documents: packing manuals, test requirements, inspection standards, document requirements.
KB_DESC: Internal policies, guides and FAQs for the team and the assistant.
TITLE: Title
ATTACH_HINT: Attach the original file (PDF, Excel, Word, image)
